description.p: Razor Sharp brings animated, typing-reactive lighting to Razer keyboards on Linux, using the OpenRazer driver. It comes with 24 effects, from ripples and lightning to an audio visualiser, a system monitor, a Pomodoro timer, and two playable games, Snake and Breakout.

ul.li: Solid, gradient, rainbow, spectrum and breathing lighting with presets
Separate brightness for the background and for the effect
Effects keep running after the window is closed, and can start at login
Key highlights, status keys, night mode, and lights off when you step away
App profiles switch effects automatically while chosen apps run
Map the keys of any keyboard with the built-in key-mapping tool
Write your own effects as short Python scripts

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Razer Inc.
Dropdown lists now close when you click elsewhere.
Settings window with key highlights, status keys, night mode, idle-off, app profiles, keyboard shortcuts and backup. Five new effects, including the game Breakout.
